title: SarcasTraps: Effect of Sarcasm on Turkish Hate Speech Detection

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the performance of fine-tuned encoders and zero-shot LLMs on detecting sarcastic versus non-sarcastic hate speech targeting immigrants, refugees, and specific nationalities (e.g., Syrians, Afghans, Pakistanis).

Evaluating the performance of fine-tuned encoders and zero-shot LLMs on detecting sarcastic versus non-sarcastic hate speech targeting specific ethnic groups (e.g., Greeks, Jewish/Israeli populations).
Evaluating the performance of fine-tuned encoders and zero-shot LLMs on detecting sarcastic versus non-sarcastic hate speech targeting religious groups (e.g., Jewish people).
